thread:
mikaela: hey everyone :wave: I’m Mikaela (joined eng-platform today). quick Q — who owns onboarding for VPC creds + dedicated model-serving deploy perms? I need s3 read/write and deploy to 'redwood-dedicated' for a demo later this week. first-week timeline is pretty tight, any shortcuts?
jamie (People Ops): welcome @mikaela!! :tada: pls follow the onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding/day0 — there’s a VPC form there. I’ll also add you to the New Hire track so infra sees it.
rajesh (infra): hey @mikaela — infra owns VPC/network access. submit a ticket in #help with subject: "vpc-onboard: <your-name>" and include subnet cidr you need + justification. Tag me and @infra-oncall if you need faster turnaround. expected SLA ~24h for simple adds.
emily (platform): hi @mikaela — platform owns Dedicated model-serving access and deploy roles. DM me your GitHub handle and the project name and I’ll add you to the redwood-dedicated team and grant `model-deployer` role. if you’re blocked now I can create a short-lived token until the team invite is done (expires EOD).
maria (dir-eng): welcome! for anything that blocks customer demos, escalate by paging infra oncall (PagerDuty) and cc infra-esc@redwood.ai. also check runbook: https://kb.redwood.ai/dedicated-onboard for required infra approvals.
rajesh (infra): quick checklist to include in the #help ticket: 1) github handle, 2) list of buckets/arn, 3) IPs/subnet, 4) project owner, 5) reason + expiration. sample snippet to paste in ticket:
```
Subject: vpc-onboard: mikaela
Body:
- Github: mikaelaGH
- Buckets: s3://redwood-staging, s3://redwood-models
- Subnet request: 10.40.0.0/24
- Owner: Mikaela (eng-platform)
- Expires: 2026-04-10
```
onboard-bot: Provisioning request received (job id: pr-2142506799). You will get updates in this thread when infra completes tasks.
mikaela: awesome, thanks all. I’ll file the ticket now and DM @emily my GH handle. tagging @jamie for any People Ops checklist items I might miss.
emily (platform): got it — I’ll pre-stage the team invite so once infra confirms network it should be fast. ping me if you don’t see the invite in 2 hours.
maria (dir-eng): small note — if you need DataDog/APM access for the demo, file a separate access request and tag me, we’ll fast-track it for demo infra.
mikaela: perfect, filing now. appreciate the quick responses :raised_hands:
